Nature Communications | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in electrochemically transforming spinel LiMn2O4 into a layered/spinel heterostructure sodium-ion cathode via Mn-ion migration, using residual spinel domains to suppress strain and degradation. Significance: this enables a viable Na-ion cathode achieving 3.85 Ah in a 26650 cell with 95.7% capacity retention after 900 cycles, demonstrating electrochemical transformation as a feasible route to design new cathode frameworks.

💡 The novelty lies in shifting from a static, material-centric view to a dynamic interface-centric framework, arguing that cycling-induced interphase evolution (polysulfides, mixed-conducting interphases) preconditions sulfide ASSB thermal runaway. item.title: Anode-free zinc batteries enabled by structurally robust solid–electrolyte interphase
item.description:
باتری‌های روی بدون آند با ایجاد یک لایه بین‌سطحی جامد-الکترولیت از نظر ساختاری پایدار فعال‌سازی می‌شوند.
Nature Sustainability | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in revealing that deep discharge causes structural collapse of the SEI exoskeleton, and in mitigating this by retaining trace reserved zinc during stripping to buffer electrode shape changes. This preserves SEI integrity, enabling 99.96% Coulombic efficiency, 38-fold cycling stability, and anode-free pouch cells retaining 90.47% capacity after 350 cycles—advancing high-energy, long-life zinc batteries.
🏷 anode-free zinc battery · solid-electrolyte interphase · zinc anode · interphase stability · aqueous battery

item.title: Stage-Resolved Evolution of Lithium-Metal Anodes: Origins of Cycle-Life Gains and Losses
item.description:

Energy & Environmental Science | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in stage-resolved tracking of lithium-metal anode morphological and interfacial evolution, linking specific stages to cycle-life gains and losses rather than relying on aggregate cycle-life metrics or discrete characterization. This resolves why durability varies, enabling targeted interventions and better prediction of anode failure, which is significant for designing longer-lasting high-capacity lithium-metal batteries.
